recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中白血球稀少，只見一顆胞質嗜鹼性、核染色質較細緻的不典型單核細胞（可能為芽細胞）與一顆小淋巴球，紅血球輕度大小不均；本圖本身缺乏足以診斷 AML-MRC 的形態特徵，需搭配骨髓與遺傳學。
features: Marked paucity of leukocytes in the field, suggesting leukopenia
One atypical mononuclear cell with moderately fine chromatin and a rim of basophilic cytoplasm, possibly a blast
One small mature lymphocyte with condensed chromatin
Red cells with mild anisocytosis and occasional elliptocytes/poikilocytes
No neutrophils to assess for dysgranulopoiesis; platelets sparse in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-to-medium power shows a paucicellular field with only two leukocytes, suggesting leukopenia. One is an atypical mononuclear cell with moderately fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm that may represent a circulating blast, and the other is a small mature lymphocyte. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional elliptocytes, and platelets appear decreased in this field. No neutrophils are present to evaluate for dysplasia. The findings are nonspecific and, while compatible with the clinical diagnosis of acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes, require correlation with bone marrow morphology, blast enumeration and cytogenetic/molecular studies.

ddx.vs: MDS may show identical cytopenias and rare circulating blasts; separation requires bone marrow blast count below 20% (or below the WHO 2022/ICC thresholds) rather than peripheral blood morphology.
Aplastic anemia shows pancytopenia without circulating blasts and a hypocellular marrow lacking dysplasia or blast excess.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and more condensed chromatin, without a population of immature blasts.
